saw_lines: Trail runners buy technical layers after checking fabric, fit and delivery, and most decide before they reach the product page.
So the delivery answer and the first offer must sit in the opening line, because buyers rarely reach the product page.
Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so open your next three ads with the delivery answer.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 18 Nov 2026
points: Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers have no reason to click today. Put the delivery answer and the shipping cost in the first line of three new ads.

0 of 22 copy ads carry a proof number, so your Swiss Made claims have nothing to check and cold buyers scroll past. Collect one number you can stand behind, like a review count, and open three new ads with it.
None of your 22 copy ads mention an offer or discount, so first time buyers have no reason to act today. Put a first order offer on the Wildstrubel pullover in line one of three new ads.

18 different openings across 22 copy ads, and the biggest, the Wildstrubel launch, opens 3. Each story runs once or twice, so the feed never builds one message buyers recognize. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them.
